name: coordination-hooks
description: Fleet coordination hooks: knowledge-base-first reminder and live session context; idle-wake; heartbeat report-alive, rotation-due watch, and rotation-due notice; memory-passthrough capture, session context, drain, hydrate, index and sync utilities; spawn-injected worker hooks; and owner-qualified receipt guards for heartbeat, rotation-due, and wake effects. Live session context (session_start_context.py) observes a register-wide digest and peer inbox counts.
